text:
Ravi Desai: heads-up: security found a high-severity libssl vuln in the ubuntu-minimal base. planning coordinated rebuild + new KMS signer rotation this Friday 01:00 PT. need RBAC + audit preflight.
Lina Morales: timeline ok. we'll freeze CI image publishes 20m before window. canaries in us-west1 then eu-west1.
Omar Steele: which KMS key name are we promoting?
Priya Nair: proposing key path projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-signers/cryptoKeys/signer-2026-04.
security-bot: SCA scan: libssl 1.1.x flagged. recommend minimal rebuild and drop unnecessary runtime libs.
Ravi Desai: checklist for preflight:
- build minimal base variant
- generate SBOM via syft -> sbom.json
- produce in-toto predicate including sbom hash
- cosign sign against KMS key and push to registry
- smoke deploy in staging w/ network egress blocked
Lina Morales: cosign example:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key kms://projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image-signers/cryptoKeys/signer-2026-04 -a sbom.json redwood/ubuntu-minimal:2026-04-09
```
Omar Steele: IAM change: restrict AsymmetricSign to serviceAccount:image-builder@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com and group:attest-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com only. no broad roles to CI runners.
Priya Nair: I'll open terraform PR with workload-identity mapping so CI uses short-lived impersonation tokens. will add a 7-day gradual rollout in the PR.
Lina Morales: logging: forward Cloud KMS audit logs and Container Analysis attestations to splunk index=sec-images and BigQuery dataset=sec_audit.images. include requestMetadata.callerIp and protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail.
security-bot: Add alert: KMS AsymmetricSign failures > 3 within 5m -> page sec-eng + SRE. Also alert if attestation missing for promoted image.
Ravi Desai: fallback: if signer-2026-04 fails, we allow emergency sign with signer-legacy for maximum 3h but must open an incident and require dual-approval (sec-eng lead + SRE). all overrides must be logged and sinked.
Priya Nair: runbook created at runbooks/image-hardening-kms-rollout.md and I'll schedule a 25m preflight Wed 16:00 PT to walk through steps.
Omar Steele: add deploy guard: admission webhook must verify cosign attestation present and sbom hash matches predicate; abort pull otherwise.
Lina Morales: PR: infra#4511 opened https://git.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/4511 requesting security review. tagging @sec-review.
Ravi Desai: thanks all. will post canary windows to #release-war-room and DM product to pause runtime changes during the window. :thumbsup:
